theorem_rows.name: physical_deduplication_closed
theorem_rows.statement: Template-index multiplicity is quotiented by physical event keys before persistence is counted.

theorem_rows.name: fixed_residue_vs_moving_residue_split_closed
theorem_rows.statement: Every unique-representative event is assigned to shape, fixed-residue packet, and fixed-slot packet ledgers.

theorem_rows.name: persistent_packet_exclusion_open
theorem_rows.statement: A global proof must exclude recurrent fixed-residue packets by ColumnCRT/PDEC or bound drifting residue shapes by SAE/Rankin.

plain_conclusion: 本步把唯一代表正规形的持久性来源拆成三层：physical 事件、fixed-residue packet、fixed-slot packet。当前重放 raw 记录 462 条，物理去重后 324 条，删除模板重复 138 条；正规形 shape 为 80 个，固定残基包为 312 个。跨不同 P 复现的固定残基包 12 个，残基或槽漂移的 moving shape 37 个。它们分别进入 ColumnCRT/PDEC 与 SAE/Rankin，全局无条件闭合仍未完成。

decision_rows.meaning: 同一物理事件的模板索引重复已合并，不再把重复模板误判为复现。
当前重放已拆成固定残基包与移动残基 shape，但仍是有限扫描证据。
12 个固定残基包跨不同 P 复现，需要 ColumnCRT/PDEC 排斥。
37 个 shape 出现残基或槽漂移，需要 SAE/Rankin 或全局增长界。
本步只是持久性路由拆分，不关闭全局行/列命题。
